SELECT tl.ledger_seq , tl.ledger_nm , tl.ledger_year , ( SELECT user_seq FROM tb_user_ledger WHERE ledger_seq= tul.ledger_seq AND master_yn = 'Y' ) AS use_seq , ( SELECT user_nm FROM tb_user WHERE user_seq = ( SELECT user_seq FROM tb_user_ledger WHERE ledger_seq= tul.ledger_seq AND master_yn = 'Y' ) ) AS user_nm , tul.master_yn , tul.auth_exit_date , tul.invite_agree_yn , tul.ledger_auth , tul.use_yn , tul.show_oneday_yn , tl.create_date FROM tb_ledger tl INNER JOIN tb_user_ledger tul ON tl.ledger_seq = tul.ledger_seq WHERE tl.del_yn = 'N' AND tul.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND tul.ledger_seq in ( SELECT ledger_seq FROM tb_user_ledger WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} )
ORDER BY tl.create_date DESC
ORDER BY tl.create_date ASC
SELECT tl.ledger_seq , tl.ledger_nm , tl.ledger_year , tl.del_yn FROM tb_ledger tl WHERE tl.ledger_seq = #{ledgerSeq} AND tl.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT tul.user_seq , tu.user_nm , tu.email , tul.ledger_seq , tul.ledger_auth , TO_CHAR(tul.auth_exit_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS auth_exit_date , tul.invite_agree_yn , tul.show_oneday_yn FROM tb_user_ledger tul LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_user tu ON tu.user_seq = tul.user_seq WHERE tul.ledger_seq = #{ledgerSeq} AND tul.use_yn = 'Y' AND tul.master_yn ='N' ORDER BY tul.user_seq
